tasks.prompt: setupapi.dev.log records USB device installs. Exactly one is a mass-storage device (its instance path starts with USBSTOR\Disk). Report its serial number and when it was first installed. The serial is the last backslash-separated component of the instance path with the trailing '&0' instance suffix removed; the first-connect time is that block's 'Section start' timestamp. Write to $W/answer.txt exactly two lines: DEVICE_SERIAL=<serial> and FIRST_CONNECT=<section start timestamp>.
tasks.reference_solution_sh:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -e
cd "${W:-.}" || exit 1
python3 - <<'PY'
import re
txt=open('setupapi.dev.log').read().splitlines()
for i,ln in enumerate(txt):
 m=re.search(r'\[Device Install[^\]]*-\s*(USBSTOR\\Disk[^\]]+)\]',ln)
 if m:
  seg=m.group(1).strip().split('\\')[-1]
  serial=re.sub(r'&\d+$','',seg)
  ts=None
  for j in range(i,i+4):
   s=re.search(r'Section start\s+([0-9/]+\s+[0-9:.]+)',txt[j])
   if s: ts=s.group(1); break
  open('answer.txt','w').write('DEVICE_SERIAL=%s\nFIRST_CONNECT=%s\n'%(serial,ts)); break
PY
